summary: DESIGN-20261102-Q5MU TD-2: reconcile the live Documentation Principles doc (docs/Engineering Guide/Documentation/01 Principles.md, 203 lines) against its canonical template (178 lines) after they drifted with no harvest ever run. Harvested three genuinely generalizable additions the live copy had and canonical lacked: (1) the Why section's rationale that frontier AI models follow ~150-200 instructions reliably before quality degrades, generalized from the literal 'CLAUDE.md' to the existing {{ROOT_INSTRUCTIONS}} placeholder; (2) the full 'Wiring Principle' section describing the progressive-disclosure navigation model (root index -> section nav -> document -> related documents) and its rules, with the project's two embedded images left out as local-only assets; (3) one added sentence to the 'Operational graph frontmatter' principle on quoting the purpose: value when it contains YAML-reserved characters. Left as intentional local-only customizations: the doc's concrete frontmatter block (id/purpose/keywords -- id is assigned per-project by this project's own docs/.og/ tool, not a template concern), both embedded /images/engineering-guide/*.png references, and the live file's older 'Diagram and format standards' wording ('every doc MUST have a Mermaid diagram' / plain classDef+style coloring) and minor SoC-test phrasing differences in Documentation destination, since canonical's current wording for those sections (Applicability-scoped diagram requirement, Default palette tokens, sequence-diagram styling note) is already a later, more nuanced revision and harvesting live's older wording would be a regression. Separately (not part of this harvest, no canonical impact): the live file independently carries two long-standing, pre-existing duplication bugs unrelated to canonical sync -- a stale duplicate 'Certainty principle' bullet and a stale duplicate 'How - doc-type cheat sheet' table, both present since at least commit 09acb50 -- fixed directly in the live file as a separate correction.
